cohort_summary: Ten phone-only bettors drove Pitch Hawk at 375x667, 390x844, 430x932 and 360x800. The phone basics work: a fixed bottom tab bar with safe-area padding, no horizontal page overflow, working hash deep-links, and a short onboarding. Game cards on Home are the most phone-friendly part. The main mobile problem is density. On a 375x667 screen the first prediction row starts ~500px down, each row is ~190px, and names truncate to 70–85px. Most tap targets are 40px, and Home pill toggles are 18px tall. One-handed users mis-tap the star next to the name. Offline handling is risky for live use: the 'Feed unreachable' banner scrolls away, and the sticky header keeps saying 'auto-refreshing'. As in every cohort, the missing sportsbook price on props means every 'pick' ends with switching to a book app. The watchlist saves a player rather than a pick, and there is no way to track a pick. Average time from open to a first usable read was ~55s; only the game-market persona fully succeeded.

personas.name: Marcus Bell
personas.profile: Pro, 9 yrs; $40k roll, $400 units; DK, FD, Circa, Pinnacle (for reference); props-first, tracks CLV in a sheet
personas.goal: Ballpark (Fenway), iPhone SE 375x667, one hand holding a beer: find a 1+ Hit prop for the BOS-NYY game priced better than fair, before the 3rd inning.
journey: Opens app; Home fold is slate meta and the 'New here?' explainer, so he taps 'Got it'.
Taps Predictions in the bottom bar (good thumb reach). Row #1 is at the bottom of the screen and he has to scroll.
Filters ▾ → All teams ▾ → picks BOS. The filter sheet pushes the list off-screen, so he closes it and scrolls again.
Scans rows: names truncated ('Julio Rodri…'); P 74%, league 65%, +9 pts; no price.
Switches to DK, finds Rodriguez 1+ Hit -250 (71.4% imp), and does the math in his head: thin edge.
Back in Pitch Hawk the poll has re-rendered; he re-finds his row and stars it. The watch pill later shows his HR read instead.
Bets in DK. Logs CLV in his own sheet, because the app has nowhere to record it.
personas.quote: Nice model, but a number with no price next to it is homework, not a pick — and at Fenway I don't have hands for homework.

pain_points.title: No book price, implied prob or edge on any prop row
pain_points.detail: Every row shows model % vs league %. With no line or price, the user has to switch to a book app, find the market, convert odds to implied probability by hand and compare. One-handed on a phone that round trip is the whole session.
pain_points.evidence: 375_pred_fold.png; frontend/pitchhawk.js:1189-1206 (batter row has P, league, lift, why; no price)
pain_points.suggested_fix: Add a compact 'Book -150 · imp 60% · edge +6' line under P() on each row, with the best book first; sort by edge.

pain_points.title: At 375x667 the first prediction row starts ~500px down; less than one row is visible
pain_points.detail: The page title, a 2-line description, the Pregame/Live segment plus Filters, the market chips, the MODEL RECORD bar, the section title, a 2-line live-mode note and the sort chips all come before row #1. Row #1 starts at y≈498 at 375x667 and 524 at 360x800, and the fixed tab bar covers its bottom. When a pin exists, the WATCHING strip pushes it down another ~65px.
pain_points.suggested_fix: On phones, collapse the description and live-mode note into a single (i), move MODEL RECORD below the list or into the Guide, and merge sort into the Filters sheet. Aim for row #1 above 250px.

pain_points.title: Player names truncate to 70–85px at 360/375 wide
pain_points.detail: 'Gunnar Alva…', 'Fernando Ro…', 'Yordan Deve…'. The matchup subline truncates too ('PHI @ A…', 'NYM @ WSH 9:1…'), which hides the first-pitch time. Team, slot and the 'pending' badge take the width the name needs. Common surnames (two Mookie Freemans, two Rodriguezes) become hard to tell apart.
pain_points.suggested_fix: Put the name on its own full-width line, move team/#slot to the subline, and drop the 'pending' badge on phones because it repeats on every row.

pain_points.title: Starring a 1+ Hit row saves the player; the watch pill then shows his 1+ HR read
pain_points.detail: Starred Gunnar Alvarez from the 1+ Hit board and the WATCHING pill showed 'G. Alvarez 1+ HR 20% +8.5 pts'. The pin key is the batter, and the pill shows whichever market has the stronger lift. Tapping the pill opens the Home game pill, not the row that was starred. The user loses the pick they meant to save.
pain_points.evidence: frontend/pitchhawk.js:806-812 (m chosen by hr.rel > hit.rel), 418-426 watchGo
pain_points.suggested_fix: Pin player+market (key b:<id>:<m>) and have the pill deep-link back to that row with it expanded.

pain_points.title: No way to log a pick with price/stake, or to track CLV
pain_points.detail: The star is the only 'save' action. It records no price, stake or time, there is no 'my picks' view, and nothing is graded against the close. Pros can't measure CLV, and amateurs can't see their record.
pain_points.suggested_fix: Add 'Track pick' in the expanded row that captures market, model %, book price (manual entry OK) and units, plus a My Picks tab graded after the final.

pain_points.title: Most controls are 40x40, and Home game-pill headers are 18px tall
pain_points.detail: At 375, 93 of 98 interactive elements on Predictions are under 44px: star 40x40, row chevron 40x40, and the player-name expand button 142x33. On Home, the game-pill toggles (e.g. 'LAD @ SD') are 97x18. The star sits right next to the name/expand button, so one-handed use mis-taps a lot: people star when they meant to expand, and the reverse.
pain_points.suggested_fix: Raise the minimum to 44px (iOS HIG) and 48dp (Android). Make the whole row card the expand target, and give the star an 8px dead zone.

pain_points.title: 8-second poll re-render detaches elements mid-interaction
pain_points.detail: During scripted taps, the Filters button detached between open and close because the whole view re-rendered. A real thumb tap landing during a poll re-render can be dropped or land on a shifted element, which is worse on slow phones.
pain_points.evidence: drive.js run 1 error 'Element is not attached to the DOM' after Filters tap; polls every 8s (pitchhawk.js:1975)
pain_points.suggested_fix: Diff-update the list instead of re-rendering wholesale, and defer the re-render while a touch is active or a sheet is open.

delights: Bottom tab bar is easy to reach with a thumb and respects the home-indicator safe area
WHY line ('30d H/PA .216 (82 PA) · Devers allows .232') is a fast sanity check

A ballpark user on bad LTE can act on frozen live numbers without knowing.
pain_points.suggested_fix: Put connection state in the sticky header (amber 'offline · last 5:22:16'). Grey out live percentages after one missed poll. Retry right away on the window 'online' event.

pain_points.detail: At 375, 93 of 98 interactive elements on Predictions are under 44px: star 40x40, row chevron 40x40, and the player-name expand button 142x33. On Home, the game-pill toggles (e.g. 'LAD @ SD') are 97x18. The star sits right next to the name/expand button, so one-handed use mis-taps a lot: people star when they meant to expand, and the reverse.
pain_points.suggested_fix: Raise the minimum to 44px (iOS HIG) and 48dp (Android). Make the whole row card the expand target, and give the star an 8px dead zone.

delights: Default market (1+ Hit) is his market
Sort chips (Lift/Prob/Time/Name) are one tap each

personas.name: Aaliyah Brooks
personas.profile: Amateur, data-curious; $300 roll, $10 units; DraftKings; learns by reading the WHY
personas.goal: Bar, iPhone 13 mini-sized phone at 375x667, in landscape to read long names: understand why the model likes a hitter and decide whether to bet.
journey: Predictions → expands row #1. Gets PHASE, LINEUP ✓, REST OF GAME 31% BASE, MATCHUP 'H2H —'. Wants splits/park.
Rotates to landscape to see full names. Header plus tab bar leave ~256px of content.
Taps 'Open game ›' → game context. Back button returns her to the top of Predictions, and she loses her place.
Decides with partial info.
personas.quote: The WHY line is the best part — I just wish expanding the row told me more than the row already did.

pain_points.title: Expanding a row reveals phase/lineup/rest-of-game/H2H, but no odds, splits or recent form
pain_points.detail: Tapping a row opens PHASE, LINEUP ✓, REST OF GAME 31%, FRESH, MATCHUP 'H2H —', and 'Open game ›'. Useful context, but there is still no price, no platoon/park split and no recent game log, so the user leaves for another app to finish the analysis.
pain_points.suggested_fix: Add price/implied, L/R split, park factor and last-10 game hits/HR to the expanded panel.

pain_points.title: In landscape (667x375), header plus bottom tab bar take 119px (32%) of the height
pain_points.detail: Turning the phone to read a long row (names untruncate in landscape) leaves about 256px of content. At 800x360 the header grows to 114px.
pain_points.suggested_fix: Hide the header on scroll-down and show it on scroll-up. In landscape, move the tabs into the header.

pain_points.title: Player names truncate to 70–85px at 360/375 wide
pain_points.detail: 'Gunnar Alva…', 'Fernando Ro…', 'Yordan Deve…'. The matchup subline truncates too ('PHI @ A…', 'NYM @ WSH 9:1…'), which hides the first-pitch time. Team, slot and the 'pending' badge take the width the name needs. Common surnames (two Mookie Freemans, two Rodriguezes) become hard to tell apart.
pain_points.suggested_fix: Put the name on its own full-width line, move team/#slot to the subline, and drop the 'pending' badge on phones because it repeats on every row.

pain_points.title: Each prop row is ~190px tall, so a 667 viewport shows 2.5 picks
pain_points.detail: Rows stack P(), league, bar, per-PA/xPA, lift, multiplier and the WHY line. The top 25 are a ~5,500px scroll, and 'Show all 36/126' sits at the bottom. Comparing picks 3 and 12 means scrolling back and forth with one thumb.
pain_points.suggested_fix: Offer a dense 1-line row on phones (name · team · P · lift · price) and keep the extra detail behind a tap. Persist that choice in localStorage.

pain_points.title: Returning from game context loses list position
pain_points.detail: After 'Open game ›' and back, she is not returned to the expanded row, so she has to scroll back through ~190px rows.
pain_points.suggested_fix: Store scrollY per route and restore it on hashchange back. Keep the row expanded.

delights: WHY line is human-readable
Landscape un-truncates names

personas.name: Ray Donnelly
personas.profile: Pro, 15 yrs; $60k roll, $500 units; sharp books plus offshore; totals and moneylines, some live
personas.goal: Pixel 8 (390-ish, tested 390x844) between innings at a bar: compare model total and win prob vs market for upcoming TOR @ CLE.
journey: Home pill shows 'ML CLE 57% · TOT O 8.5 60%'. Fast and clear.
Expands the pill (▸ 40x40) for more context. No market line or price, though the backend has game-market edge (/edge) that isn't served here.
Predictions → Win prob / Totals chips. Same numbers ranked by lift.
Converts 57% to -133 fair in his head and checks his book. Edge found in about 40s.
personas.quote: Game cards are the most phone-friendly thing here — put the market price beside that 57% and it's a daily open.

pain_points.title: Probabilities are never converted to fair American odds
pain_points.detail: Every bettor converts % to fair odds in their head, which is slow and error-prone one-handed.
pain_points.suggested_fix: Show fair odds (-133) under or beside every probability, with a toggle for decimal.

pain_points.title: No book price, implied prob or edge on any prop row
pain_points.detail: Every row shows model % vs league %. With no line or price, the user has to switch to a book app, find the market, convert odds to implied probability by hand and compare. One-handed on a phone that round trip is the whole session.
pain_points.evidence: 375_pred_fold.png; frontend/pitchhawk.js:1189-1206 (batter row has P, league, lift, why; no price)
pain_points.suggested_fix: Add a compact 'Book -150 · imp 60% · edge +6' line under P() on each row, with the best book first; sort by edge.

delights: Home game pills pack ML, total and top read into one card
Win prob delta (▲16) since open is a nice live signal

personas.name: Lena Fischer
personas.profile: Amateur, new to MLB props (ex-NBA bettor); $250 roll, $5 units; FanDuel; wants guidance
personas.goal: Android 360x800 on the couch, flaky Wi-Fi: learn the board and place a first MLB prop within 5 minutes.
journey: Reads 'New here?' → 'How to read the board' overlay. Helpful.
Predictions: Pregame vs Live toggle, 'reads froze at first pitch', 'pending' badge on every row. Unsure what 'pending' means.
Filter bar: count '126 results' clipped at the edge; the min-lift slider label is off-screen.
Wi-Fi drops; the banner appears at the top but she's scrolled and misses it. Tapping does nothing for a few seconds.
Finds a +12 pts hit read and bets it.
personas.quote: The guide helped, but half the labels — pending, BASE, frozen — I had to guess.

pain_points.title: Results count, min-lift value and later chips are clipped off the right edge
pain_points.detail: At 375, the '126 results' count and the slider's 'any' label are cut off at the right edge. The Starters chip (the only route to Ks/Outs) and the 'Final' status chip are off-screen in a horizontal scroller with no visible affordance.
pain_points.suggested_fix: Wrap the filter bar onto two lines on phones. Show the count under the title. Add a fade or arrow at the scroller edge, or put markets in a 2x3 grid.

pain_points.title: Offline state is easy to miss: header still says 'auto-refreshing' and the banner scrolls away
pain_points.detail: With the network off for 20s, a 'Feed unreachable' banner rendered in the page flow at the top. Scrolled into the list, nothing shows it, and the sticky header kept saying '3 games live · auto-refreshing' with a green dot. Ten seconds after reconnecting, the banner was still present. A ballpark user on bad LTE can act on frozen live numbers without knowing.
pain_points.suggested_fix: Put connection state in the sticky header (amber 'offline · last 5:22:16'). Grey out live percentages after one missed poll. Retry right away on the window 'online' event.

pain_points.title: At 375x667 the first prediction row starts ~500px down; less than one row is visible
pain_points.detail: The page title, a 2-line description, the Pregame/Live segment plus Filters, the market chips, the MODEL RECORD bar, the section title, a 2-line live-mode note and the sort chips all come before row #1. Row #1 starts at y≈498 at 375x667 and 524 at 360x800, and the fixed tab bar covers its bottom. When a pin exists, the WATCHING strip pushes it down another ~65px.
pain_points.suggested_fix: On phones, collapse the description and live-mode note into a single (i), move MODEL RECORD below the list or into the Guide, and merge sort into the Filters sheet. Aim for row #1 above 250px.

pain_points.title: Player names truncate to 70–85px at 360/375 wide
pain_points.detail: 'Gunnar Alva…', 'Fernando Ro…', 'Yordan Deve…'. The matchup subline truncates too ('PHI @ A…', 'NYM @ WSH 9:1…'), which hides the first-pitch time. Team, slot and the 'pending' badge take the width the name needs. Common surnames (two Mookie Freemans, two Rodriguezes) become hard to tell apart.
pain_points.suggested_fix: Put the name on its own full-width line, move team/#slot to the subline, and drop the 'pending' badge on phones because it repeats on every row.

pain_points.title: 'pending', 'BASE', 'PREGAME · FROZEN', 'FROM ORDER' badges have no tap-to-explain
pain_points.detail: Badges repeat on every row and take width from player names, and the meaning isn't clear without the Guide.
pain_points.suggested_fix: Tap a badge to get a one-line tooltip sheet. Hide 'pending' on phones.

delights: Onboarding explainer is concise
Responsible-gambling footer present
